integrity: The exact law is proved from coordinate-rank permutations and a probability-generating function. The asymptotic follows analytically from fixed-degree elementary symmetric sums and the exact remainder formula in Theorem 3.9. Finite computation is supplementary only.
limitations: The theorem concerns the bivariate independent-coordinate model and the complete-kill component. It proves the fixed-k remainder asymptotic but not the uniform-in-k error rate or the empirical-frequency conjectures from Section 4 of the motivating paper.
title: A Stirling law for complete bivariate-record kills and the sharp fixed-k error constant
